reference.name: Rev OCEAN
reference.state: neutral baseline, Mix 100 %, Macro 0 except in the macro part (Macro 100 %)

laws.delay: D[samples] = fixed(fs) + (fs/44100) floor(P s + 0.5); s = Size/100, P = lengthAt100 (whole 44.1 kHz samples)
laws.modulation: position p = D + (fs/44100) A sin(theta) with theta taken when the arrival is read; A = 0.88 ms; theta is a float32 phase that grows by float32(2 pi 0.6/44100) per 44.1 kHz sample and wraps at 2 pi (0.599878 Hz)
laws.gain: gain = tap w(T) 10^(-3 P s / (44100 T)); T = Decay in seconds; w(T) = 1 + slope (min(T, 6) - 0.5)
